reply: Hi Sam, your Vale L4 USB prints through a USB cable. It has no Wi-Fi radio or wireless setup button, and a USB Wi-Fi adapter won't add wireless printing. To print from your laptop, connect the included USB cable and follow the L4 USB driver guide for your laptop's operating system. If wireless printing is essential, contact support to discuss compatible models. Return or exchange eligibility would need to be checked; this manual excerpt does not establish either option.
